factors.formula_text: -0.25*zscore(amount_mean_20d) + -0.2*zscore(turnover_mean_20d) + -0.2*zscore(turnover_std_20d) + 0.2*zscore(amihud_20d) + -0.15*zscore(log_amount)

factors.label: 中期趋势复合
factors.formula_text: 0.2*zscore(momentum_30d) + 0.1*zscore(ma5_bias) + 0.2*zscore(ma30_bias) + 0.15*zscore(ema20_bias) + 0.1*zscore(ema30_bias) + 0.1*zscore(ema60_bias) + 0.15*zscore(macd_dif_pct)

factors.label: 价格位置复合

factors.formula_text: -0.3*zscore(momentum_5d) + -0.15*zscore(momentum_10d) + -0.15*zscore(rsi_14_delta_5d) + 0.2*zscore(close_position) + -0.1*zscore(turnover_z_60d) + -0.1*zscore(max_ret_20d)

factors.label: 短期风险反转复合

factors.formula_text: ocf_ni - accrual

factors.formula_text: 1 - ((close - low) / (high - low))

factors.formula_text: core_earnings_ratio

factors.label: E/P(ROE/PB合成)
factors.formula_text: roe_latest / (100 * pb_latest)

factors.label: 四因子一致数
factors.formula_text: if_else(rank(momentum_60d) > 0.6, 1, 0) + if_else(rank(roe_latest / (100.0 * pb_latest) - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) > 0.6, 1, 0) + if_else(rank(ocf_ni - accrual) > 0.6, 1, 0) + if_else(rank(0.0 - annual_vol_20d) > 0.6, 1, 0)

factors.label: 行业相对强弱五日变化
factors.formula_text: ts_delta(ext_alt_hs300_stock_rel_industry_20d, 5)

factors.label: 日内反转
factors.formula_text: 0 - (close / open - 1)

factors.label: 日内风险占比
factors.formula_text: ts_std(close / open - 1, 20) / (ts_std(open / prev_close - 1, 20) + ts_std(close / open - 1, 20) + 0.00000001)

factors.label: 低成交额(流动性折价)
factors.formula_text: 0 - log(amount + 1)

factors.label: 低成交额(20日均值)
factors.formula_text: 0 - log(ts_mean(amount, 20) + 1)

factors.label: 低换手
factors.formula_text: 0 - turnover_rate

factors.label: 低波动
factors.formula_text: 0 - annual_vol_20d

factors.label: 低波动(60日)
factors.formula_text: 0 - ts_std(close / prev_close - 1, 60) * sqrt(252)

factors.label: Merton结构化违约距离代理
factors.formula_text: log(1.0 + pb_latest * (1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (debt_ratio_latest / 100.0)) * (1.0 + pb_latest * (1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (debt_ratio_latest / 100.0)) / (annual_vol_20d * pb_latest * (1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (debt_ratio_latest / 100.0)) - 0.5 * annual_vol_20d * pb_latest * (1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (1.0 + pb_latest * (1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / (debt_ratio_latest / 100.0))

factors.label: 质量价值防守
factors.formula_text: roe_latest / (100 * pb_latest) - debt_ratio_latest / 100

factors.label: 10日反转
factors.formula_text: 0 - momentum_10d

factors.label: 5日反转
factors.formula_text: 0 - momentum_5d

factors.formula_text: log((1.0 - debt_ratio_latest / 100.0) / annual_vol_20d)
